PromptTemplate: What is the total surface area of {subject_entity} in square kilometres, as recorded in Wikidata under property P2046 (area)? Give the figure Wikidata lists as its preferred value, which for an island or lake means the whole feature including its associated islets or administrative unit, not just the main landmass. For countries include land plus inland water. If you recall the figure in another unit, convert it explicitly: 1 square mile = 2.58999 km2, 1 hectare = 0.01 km2. Give at least three significant figures and do not round to the nearest hundred or thousand. Answer with the bare number only: no unit, no thousands separators, no words.

What is the maximum spectator capacity of {subject_entity}, as a whole number of people? If several capacities are published (seated versus total, or before versus after renovation), give the highest one. Give the exact published figure rather than a round approximation. Answer with the bare number only: no thousands separators, no words.

Which currently recognised countries or comparable territories share a land border with {subject_entity}? Exclude maritime borders and disputed or deprecated border claims. If it is an island country with no land border, answer None.

In which city did {subject_entity} die? First decide whether this person is deceased. If they are deceased, name the city even if you are not fully certain — the city only, not the country, region or state. Only answer None if the person is still living or no death is recorded.

Which people, groups or organisations have received this award: {subject_entity}? List every recipient you know, separated by commas. Do not include recipients of predecessor or successor awards with similar names, and name the recipients rather than the winning works.

On which stock exchanges are shares of {subject_entity} publicly traded? First decide whether this is a publicly listed company at all: private firms, brands, subsidiaries of a listed parent, and production or holding entities that are not separately listed have no exchange, and for those answer None. If it is publicly listed but you are unsure which exchange, name the principal exchange of the country it is based in rather than answering None, since a listed company's primary listing is almost always its home exchange. List every exchange where it is listed, using the exchange's common name.
